note:
R137c - the R137 structural measurements on PS3 NHL 11 / 12 / 13 venue packages, which ship ONLY as archive members (NHL 11
`stadium.big`, NHL 12 / 13 `cacherender.big`; no loose rendering/stadium). Each member is unwrapped (chunkzip) into package-owned scratch,
analysed with R137 `analyse(..., ps3=True)`, and deleted. Read-only on the installs.
Usage: python r137c_ps3_archived_venue_packages.py <out.json> <scratch dir>
